**3-Year Data Science & AI Professional Program**

**624 Hours · 36 Months · Absolute Beginner → Professional / Job-Ready**

*Fixed, Fully Rebuilt Edition — All 624 Lectures Individually Authored, No Templated or Duplicate Content*

**1. Program Purpose and Graduate Outcome**

This is a complete 3-year, 624-hour Data Science & AI specialization for a Class-10-pass absolute beginner. Year 1 (Months 1-12) builds computing, Python, SQL, statistics, NumPy/Pandas, visualization, exploratory data analysis, business analytics and dashboarding, plus HackerRank Python/SQL certificates, the Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, and Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900). Year 2 (Months 13-24) builds machine learning foundations, feature engineering, classification, unsupervised learning, time series, data engineering, ML deployment/MLOps, and the IBM Data Science and IBM Data Engineering Professional Certificates, plus Microsoft AI-300 (the current replacement for the retired DP-100). Year 3 (Months 25-36) builds advanced ML, deep learning, NLP, computer vision, generative AI/RAG, large-scale data engineering, responsible AI, advanced MLOps, and a professional final capstone with a GitHub portfolio.

By graduation, a student can: clean, analyze and visualize real datasets end-to-end; write production-quality Python and SQL; train, evaluate and deploy classical ML, deep learning and generative AI models; build and operate data engineering pipelines; reason about responsible/fair AI; and present a documented, tested, deployed capstone project as the flagship of a professional GitHub portfolio.

**3. Certifications and Professional Credentials Covered**

**•** HackerRank Python & SQL Certificates — skill-verification badges (not domain-weighted exams) earned in Months 2-3, with a re-validation window noted in Months 13-14.

**•** Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate — taught across Months 7-12 and assessed in Month 11. Accurately presented as a 9-course Coursera professional certificate (no single proctored exam) ending in a capstone case study.

**•** Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Fundamentals (DP-900) — taught and assessed in Month 12. A single exam: 4 domains (Describe core data concepts 25-30%; relational data on Azure 20-25%; non-relational data on Azure 15-20%; analytics workload on Azure 25-30%), 45 minutes, pass score 700/1000.

**•** IBM Data Science Professional Certificate — taught across Months 13-22, assessed in Month 22. A 12-course Coursera professional certificate (no single exam) ending in an applied capstone.

**•** Microsoft AI-300 (Machine Learning Operations Engineer Associate) — taught across Months 20-24. This document corrects the source program's reference to DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate), which Microsoft retired on 1 June 2026: AI-300 is DP-100's current replacement, with 5 domains (MLOps infrastructure 15-20%; ML model lifecycle and operations 25-30%; GenAIOps infrastructure 20-25%; generative AI quality assurance and observability 10-15%; optimizing generative AI systems 10-15%).

**•** IBM Data Engineering Professional Certificate — taught across Months 18-24, assessed in Month 23. A 16-course Coursera professional certificate (no single exam) ending in a data-engineering capstone.

**4. Teaching and Assessment Model**

**•** Each numbered lecture is one guided teaching hour, plus homework outside the guided hour.

**•** Every lecture across all 624 is written specifically for its own angle on that lecture's topic — including consecutive lectures that share an identical title (a multi-lecture topic run), which now carry genuinely different content (core mechanics, a deeper variant, a worked example, hands-on practice, or synthesis) rather than repeated or templated text.

**•** Every month ends in a dedicated Month Examination lecture covering that month's full content; where the month's title or cert window names a certification, that lecture includes real, currently accurate exam/readiness facts, and external exams/certificates are always noted as optional with costs/availability subject to change and to be verified by the student before registering.

**•** DP-100's retirement (1 June 2026) is explicitly noted rather than silently carried over from the flawed source document; Microsoft AI-300 is taught in its place as the current credential.

**•** Lecture 624 closes the entire 3-year program as a capstone-and-graduation lecture, and from early in Year 1 onward, work is expected to be committed to a public GitHub portfolio, culminating in Year 3 Month 35's dedicated portfolio-and-interview month.

**What Was Fixed in This Edition**

This document was produced after a structural and content review of an earlier 624-lecture, 36-month draft. That review found the month-by-month timeline (36 months, 624 lectures, stated hour totals, no gaps or duplicate lecture numbers) was internally consistent, but found severe, systemic content defects, confirmed by exact-text and whole-document analysis:

**•** 94% of the original document's 624 lectures (588 of 624) reused one identical template paragraph with only the lecture's own topic phrase substituted in.

**•** Each month's core topics were each stretched across 2-5 consecutive lectures sharing the exact same title, and 446 of the 624 lectures (71%) were byte-for-byte identical in body content to at least one sibling lecture — the same lecture effectively pasted multiple times to fill out the month's hours.

**•** Every certification-named month contained zero genuine certification facts in its examination lecture despite the month's own title naming that certification.

**•** The original document marketed DP-100 (Azure Data Scientist Associate) as a current certification, despite Microsoft having retired DP-100 on 1 June 2026 and recommending AI-300 (MLOps Engineer Associate) as its replacement.

The fixes made in this edition:

**•** Every one of the program's 624 lectures has been individually authored with its own genuine teacher explanation, worked example, knowledge-check question and homework task — no templated boilerplate or duplicated content remains anywhere in the document, including within multi-lecture same-titled topic runs, each of which now progresses through genuinely distinct angles (core mechanics, a deeper variant, a real worked example, hands-on practice, or synthesis).

**•** Every certification-named examination lecture now contains real, currently verified facts (HackerRank Python/SQL, Google Data Analytics Professional Certificate, DP-900, IBM Data Science, AI-300, IBM Data Engineering), correctly distinguishing single-exam credentials from the multi-course Coursera certificates' no-single-exam structure.

**•** DP-100 is replaced throughout with AI-300, Microsoft's current credential, with DP-100's retirement explicitly noted rather than silently carried over.

**•** The verified-correct skeleton is unchanged: 36 months, 624 sequential lectures, and the same month-by-month hour allocation, confirmed to sum to exactly 624 and to match the lecture count in every month.

**Year 1 — Foundations**

**Month 1 Computer, Data & Python Foundations**
